encoding.64:143: five 16-byte functional records inherited from R0-E; last two bytes reserved zero
encoding.144:159: RT observation header; +7 acquisition status 127=complete, not timing pass
encoding.160:239: five cases x 16 modulo-256 raster deltas in requested phase order (phase index x 16)

limitations: Unpaced 21-stage functional model, not real 100Hz scheduling
Synthetic input/audio and fault counters, not hardware service or overflow proof
Phase acquisition is bounded to 65535 reads; sampled start can lag requested phase
Modulo-256 wraps unresolved; no elapsed-time ordering, cycles or latency
Synchronous snapshot proxy, not concurrency proof
DMA and IRQ measurement not executed
Physical platform identity requires external capture
abi: LLVM-MOS pinned C ABI; private raster helper reads D012 only; inherited R0-A startup sets B=02 and fini B=00; no new assembly
canonical_state: ROM-hosted standalone proof; no claim that stock ROM MAP/IRQ context satisfies production canonical MemoryAccessABI
storage: No storage call after program entry
